title: Following the child's trace saddle
description: Stacked mobile rendering of the same accepted continuation samples; no new scientific data.
alt_text: The child's corrected trace saddle falls from positive height at zero memory to negative height at 0.7% memory, with a numerical zero estimate near 0.645%; a second panel shows the saddle moving toward stronger steering and lower log-temperature.

data_source.selection: Every audited accepted sample; identical points and marker as desktop view.

uncertainty: Empirical numerical data. Lines connect accepted samples, not a continuous-path certificate. The root meets a trace-residual tolerance; no exact-zero or tight parameter-interval certificate.
